svg.aria-label: Thought press: numbered thought cards ride a rail on small carriages, the dot count on each card standing for its thought number, and the press die stamps the card beneath it. A switchyard splits the rail so one card branches off, a revision arm carries a card back toward an earlier slot, the counting drum keeps the thought history against its 1000 cap, and the lit orange gate guards the output tray. The input comb carries nine pegs, four tall for the required inputs and five short for the optional ones, and the twin inlet blocks are the two protocol eras served on stdio. Verified numbers: @modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking v2.2.0, updated Nov 18, 2026; one tool, sequentialthinking; 9 inputs, 4 required and 5 optional; 2 protocol eras; history cap 1000; Streamable HTTP on 127.0.0.1:3001/mcp; Node.js 24 or later.
